verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਦਰ ਸਰੋਜ ਬਾਂਸ ਬਾਵਨ ਮਰਾਲ ਬਗ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਖਾਨ ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhaadhar saroj baa(n)s baavan maraal bag paaras pakhaan bikh a(n)mirat sa(n)jog hai ||

en.bdb: A frog and lotus flower, a bamboo and sandalwood tree, a crane and a swan, an ordinary stone and a philosopher-stone, nectar and poison may come together, yet do not adopt each other's characteristics.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਮਦ ਅਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਮਧ ੁਮਾਖੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਬਾਂਝ ਬਧੂ ਨਾਹ ਨੇਹ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਭੋਗ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: mirag miragamadh eh man madh umaakhee saakhee baa(n)jh badhoo naeh neh nihafal bhog hai ||

en.bdb: Deer has musk in its naval, a cobra has a pearl in its hood, a bee lives with honey, a sterile woman gets to meet with her husband with love but all in vain.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਕਰ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਲੂ ਬਰਖੈ ਸਮੈ ਜਵਾਸੋ ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਵੰਤ ਰੋਗ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhinakar jot uloo barakhai samai javaaso asan basan jaise birathaava(n)t rog hai ||

en.bdb: Just as Sun's light for an owl, rain for a wild herb (javran-alhogi maunosum) and clothes and food for a patient are like disease.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੀਜ ਜਮਤ ਨ ਕਾਲਰ ਮੈ ਅੰਕੁਰ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੋਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਬਿਓਗ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੯॥
verses.translit_en: taise gurmat beej jamat na kaalar mai a(n)kur udhot hot naahin biog hai ||299||

en.bdb: Similarly sullied and vice-ridden hearts cannot be fertile to the seeds of Guru's sermons and teachings. It just does not sprout. Such a person remains separated from his God. (299)
